last_recap: He bursts into the bustling market, pulse racing, amber seed clutched, vendors shouting, spices swirling, sunrise gilding stalls. A hooded merchant slides a cracked map across the wooden table, ink glimmering, promise of water whispered among strangers. He strides toward towering city gates, iron clang echoing, soldiers marching, banners snapping, sky bruised with twilight. A guard pauses, eyes widening at the glowing seed, whispers of ancient rites stir, hope flickers anew. Inside the citadel courtyard, marble fountains sputter, courtiers gossip, lanterns sway, his heart pounds beneath vaulte
ending_cliffhanger: A tremor shakes the courtyard, river's voice roars, the ancient irrigation channel awakens, water surges through the valley.
